intelligence.enrichment: Rechargeable batteries can be recharged and reused multiple times, unlike dry cells that are single-use. battery designed for recharge -> charging restores use for multiple cycles -> less wastage and money saved over time; dry cell used up -> disposal is required The learner correctly applies this rule: Rechargeable batteries can be recharged and reused multiple times, unlike dry cells that are single-use. Any battery can be charged again if it is put into a charger for long enough.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: magnetic and heating effects. The student must decide: Classify a battery as rechargeable rather than single-use by whether it can be recharged and reused multiple times. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options).
